tests.name: missing_actors_when_docs_are_forked

tests.name: multiple_batch_inserts

tests.name: mutliple_insertions_at_same_list_position_with_insertion_by_greater_actor_id

tests.name: mutliple_insertions_at_same_list_position_with_insertion_by_lesser_actor_id

tests.name: both_peers_read_only
tests.rationale: Two peers with independent changes enter read-only mode and exchange no document changes.

tests.name: both_peers_read_only_converges_to_none
tests.rationale: Both read-only peers quiesce while retaining distinct local heads.

tests.name: both_read_only_both_make_local_changes
tests.rationale: Both peers begin with independent local changes that remain isolated during read-only synchronization.

tests.name: both_read_only_one_makes_local_changes
tests.rationale: Both peers are read-only; local changes on one are not transferred to the other and the session still quiesces.

tests.name: both_read_only_simultaneous_changes_during_sync
tests.rationale: Both read-only peers make simultaneous changes across two rounds; neither receives the other's data and both quiesce.

tests.name: both_toggle_after_multiple_read_only_rounds
tests.rationale: Both peers accumulate changes across read-only rounds and exchange all of them after both switch to read-write.

tests.name: both_toggle_read_only_to_read_write_simultaneously
tests.rationale: Both peers switch to read-write simultaneously and converge their prior local changes.

tests.name: both_toggle_read_only_to_read_write_with_new_changes
tests.rationale: Independent changes created before the simultaneous transition are exchanged after reset.

tests.name: changes_not_sent_to_read_only_peer
tests.rationale: The publisher discovers read-only mode and quiesces without repeatedly sending document changes.

tests.name: first_response_is_some_even_if_no_changes
tests.rationale: Two peers at identical heads still exchange a first sync message so each learns the other's heads.

tests.name: generate_message_after_set_read_only_even_with_in_flight
tests.rationale: Changing to read-only forces a new message while an earlier message remains in flight.

tests.name: generate_message_after_set_read_only_false_even_with_in_flight
tests.rationale: Changing back to read-write forces a reset message despite an in-flight message.

tests.name: generate_sync_message_twice_does_nothing
tests.rationale: A second generation attempt while a message is in flight returns no message.

tests.name: in_flight_logic_should_not_sabotage_concurrent_changes
tests.rationale: A reference peer commits another change while its previous message is awaiting acknowledgement.

tests.name: peer_discovers_remote_read_only_status
tests.rationale: PeerReadOnly is asserted after flag exchange for native and Rust publishers.

tests.name: read_only_empty_peer_syncs_with_data_peer
tests.rationale: An empty read-only peer exchanges protocol state with a populated peer without applying its document.

tests.name: read_only_fully_connected_triangle
tests.rationale: A read-only peer publishes to two read-write peers that then merge; both gain all three change sets while the publisher keeps only its own.

tests.name: read_only_peer_concurrent_changes_during_sync
tests.rationale: A read-only peer that commits a change mid-flight still publishes it to the read-write peer, which the read-only peer never consumes in return.

tests.name: read_only_peer_new_changes_between_sync_rounds
tests.rationale: A read-only publisher's new changes flow to the read-write peer as a conflict while the publisher never receives the consumer's data.

tests.name: read_only_peer_receives_same_changes_from_two_peers
tests.rationale: A read-only publisher announced the same changes by two peers keeps only its own history and later distributes a new change to both.

tests.name: read_only_publisher_to_multiple_consumers
tests.rationale: A read-only publisher's changes reach two independent consumers, and one consumer's changes never reach the other through the publisher.

tests.name: read_only_sync_does_not_apply_incoming_changes
tests.rationale: Native and Rust read-only receivers reject incoming changes in both engine directions.

tests.name: should_allow_simultaneous_messages_during_synchronisation
tests.rationale: Two peers each committing five concurrent changes exchange messages in both directions and converge to identical heads with each other's keys.

tests.name: should_not_reply_if_we_have_no_data_after_first_round
tests.rationale: Two empty peers exchange a mandatory first message each, then fall silent once neither has anything to send.

tests.name: stale_shared_heads_after_read_only_sync
tests.rationale: A consumer that already has the read-only publisher's changes via a third peer re-syncs directly and still quiesces without the publisher accepting data.

tests.name: switch_read_only_to_read_write_mid_session
tests.rationale: A read-only peer switches to read-write, requests a reset, receives prior changes, and converges.

tests.name: switch_read_only_to_read_write_with_multiple_rounds
tests.rationale: A read-only peer that ignored several rounds of changes receives all of them after switching to read-write and converges.

tests.name: switch_read_write_to_read_only_mid_session
tests.rationale: A peer switched to read-only mid-session still publishes its own new change but no longer accepts the peer's new change.

tests.name: toggle_read_only_multiple_times
tests.rationale: Toggling read-only on and off across rounds gates change acceptance correctly and converges once read-write.

tests.name: triangle_changes_arrive_via_two_paths
tests.rationale: Three peers relay concurrent changes through native and reference engines and converge to identical heads.
